BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to geoducks; amending RCW 79.96.085; and adding newsections to chapter 79.96 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.96 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state and federally recognized Indian tribes must provide thelabor and equipment necessary to reseed publicly owned aquatic landsafter a geoduck harvest.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79.96.085 and 1990 c 163 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of natural resources shall designate the areasof aquatic lands owned by the state that are available for geoduckharvesting by licensed geoduck harvesters in accordance with chapter79.90 RCW. (2) The department of natural resources must offer to lease toprivate parties aquatic lands that have already been harvested ofgeoducks for the purpose of allowing private parties to reseed andculture geoducks. p. 1 SB 5400 (3) A freefloating geoduck is the property of the landowner onwhose property the geoduck alights.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.96 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of natural resources shall lease aquatic landsbeyond seventy feet mean low water (0.0. ft.) for geoduck harvesting.
